# Decision

* [Rendering target: appears correct, not physically correct](2026-10-13-appears-correct-not-physically-correct.md) - "Accurate" lighting and materials means looking right to the eye; physical correctness is not required.
* [Defer competition-rule checks and pain-point research](2026-10-13-defer-competition-rules-and-pain-points.md) - FIG / USA Gymnastics / NCAA attire checks and coach/parent pain-point research are out of scope for now.
* [Target platform: native desktop and iPad](2026-10-13-native-desktop-and-ipad-target.md) - The product ships as a native desktop app plus iPad/tablet app; browser prototyping is acceptable and share-by-link is not a priority.
* [Prefer free and openly licensed assets](2026-10-13-prefer-free-open-assets.md) - Work from free, openly licensed data and tools (CC0, MIT, Apache, unencumbered GPL output) rather than buying assets.
* [Coach designs come from a leotard maker's catalogue](2026-10-15-coach-designs-come-from-maker-catalogue.md) - The tool is used by a leotard maker; its club customers (coaches, gym owners) customise designs from that maker's catalogue.
* [Designs move between people as files](2026-10-15-design-files-for-handover.md) - For now a design passes between roles as a saved file; no accounts or server. The format should allow sync later.
* [First release: designer tools, proven by pattern output](2026-10-15-designer-first-proven-by-patterns.md) - Build the editable garment model for the designer first, with flat pattern pieces as its first proof; the coach view follows as a restricted mode.
* [Keep all project knowledge in Open Knowledge Format](2026-10-15-knowledge-in-okf.md) - All knowledge produced as the project proceeds is saved in an OKF v0.2 bundle in the knowledge/ subdirectory.
* [POC complete; build a professional, role-based tool](2026-10-15-poc-complete-move-to-professional-tool.md) - The proof of concept is considered finished; the next phase develops it into a professional tool for gyms and coaches, designers and seamstresses, each with a different view.
* [Seamstress output: printable PDF patterns](2026-10-15-printable-pdf-patterns.md) - Flattened pattern pieces are delivered as printable full-scale PDFs with markings and measurements; DXF and graded size runs are not required now.
* [Engine: three.js, not Unreal](2026-10-15-threejs-over-unreal.md) - After building POCs in both, the owner chose three.js for lightness and fast iteration; the Unreal POC was removed.
* [The moodboard is the designer tool's acceptance set](2026-10-18-moodboard-is-the-acceptance-set.md) - Any design in the owner's 138-photo moodboard must be achievable with in-app tools; the owner will test the finished tool by handing over one leotard photo to rebuild, judged on form and appearance.
* [Owner review of the panel: presets change only the leotard, all Daz poses, Stacy as the person](2026-10-21-owner-review-presets-poses-stacy.md) - Owner feedback of 2026-10-21 on the revamped panel: a design preset changes only the leotard (never the pose, body or lighting); HDRI studios show a plain backdrop unless the photographed room is wanted, with its floor projection adjustable; glare much weaker by default with size and strength settings; lights never circle by default; material tiles pre-rendered on twisted cloth in one row; a texture-size setting for every material; all 30 Skillful Routine poses, and none of the arm-only poses in the picker; the person is Stacy (her face and skin on every age and build), with no skin-tone choice.
* [Visual side panel, two body appearances, one skin tone on every body](2026-10-21-visual-panel-two-appearances.md) - Owner decisions of 2026-10-21: the side panel becomes picture tiles (no drop-downs where a choice can be shown), the moodboard designs B1-B13 are the presets and the POC looks are retired, the body is shown either as a headless plastic mannequin or as a realistic person, and the person keeps one skin tone at every age and build (a tone picker is fine because it re-bakes nothing).
* [Simplify the app around building blocks and starting points](2026-10-23-simplify-around-building-blocks.md) - Owner direction of 2026-10-23: strip the interface to what crafting a leotard needs (settings and rarely used controls go behind the settings panel or a disclosure); offer simple starting points (the plainest a tank with a gradient front, a solid back, a crew neck and no stones) beside the moodboard designs; abstract the common moodboard patterns into mix-and-match elements (neckline, back, sleeves, leg, front top, waist seam); picking an element changes only that element, asking first when it would take something away; materials ordered by how often the moodboard uses them; precise tools stay for the rest.
* [Owner fabric review: default texture sizes, softer wet look, smooth foils, seven fabrics removed](2026-10-24-owner-fabric-review.md) - Owner review of 2026-10-24: per-fabric default texture sizes (matte lycra 185%, mystique 75%, liquid hologram and oil-slick foil 325%, pink organza 125%, pink oil-slick vegan leather 400%); wet look toned down from latex to cire; the foils, film, chrome and velvets lose their crinkle bump; lace, shattered glass hologram and five scanned fabrics leave the picker, with old designs falling back to a stand-in.
* [Shoulder straps: an element the neckline, back and armhole start from](2026-10-24-shoulder-straps-as-anchor.md) - Owner decision of 2026-10-24: the app's tank strap (10-12.5 cm across the shoulder, whatever was left between the neck and the armhole) was far wider than real tank leotards (about 1-4 cm). Sleeveless designs get a Straps element with four options (tank about 5 cm, narrow about 3 cm, thin about 1 cm, racer); the neckline and back run between the straps' inner edges and the armhole from their outer edge, so they always match; necklines and backs a strap cannot hold are greyed out; the Straps row shows only on a tank design.
* [Sports-bra bust: Daz BreastsFlatten at 1 and In-Out at 0.5 on every body past childhood](2026-10-25-sports-bra-bust.md) (deprecated) - Owner decision of 2026-10-25: the bodies' natural bust read wrong for an athlete in a sports bra or lined leotard. Every body from the young teen up is baked with body_ctrl_BreastsFlatten 1 and body_ctrl_BreastsIn-Out 0.5; only shape and pectoral controls, re-applied after each pose preset so they hold in all poses. Extending flatten past 1, the HyperionStudio shapes, lift and a procedural compression shape were compared and set aside for now.
* [Sports-bra bust by taut cloth: flatten 25%, in-out 1, lift 2 cm, then a cloth drape baked into the skin](2026-10-25-sports-bra-cloth-bust.md) - Owner decision of 2026-10-25: the bust is shaped by a procedural recipe that works on any body (Daz BreastsFlatten 0.25 and BreastsIn-Out 1.0, a 2 cm lift, then our own taut-membrane cloth drape over a bra band, the skin settled onto it), replacing flatten 1 / in-out 0.5. Prototype in pipeline/daz/bust_cloth/; not baked into the bodies yet.
* [Seat: the gluteal cleft spanned by a taut grid cloth drawn on every pose's body](2026-10-26-seat-cleft-cloth.md) - Owner decision of 2026-10-25/26: the body itself is smoothed at the seat, cleft only (the cheeks and the crease under them untouched), so the fabric fitting has less to do. A grid cloth across the cleft, pressed gently into it (a smooth dip, cheeks still separate), cut where other skin is in front, the skin slid onto it; drawn on each Daz pose's own body. Built into the bodies by pipeline/daz/shapes.py.
* [Lighting: photographed (HDRI) studios only; test materials in the White loft studio](2026-10-27-hdri-lighting-only.md) - Owner decision of 2026-10-27: the app offers only the five photographed HDRI studios (White loft, Window loft, Parquet sunlit, Green loft hall, Neon studio); the light-only and softbox rigs (Arena, Studio (soft), Single spotlight, White and Grey seamless, Gym) and the circling-lights switch are removed, and material realism is tested in the White loft studio.
* [A softbox studio lit by analytic area lights, added back to test satin](2026-10-27-softbox-studio-for-satin.md) (deprecated) - Owner decision of 2026-10-27, hours after removing every non-HDRI rig: add one analytic studio (Softbox studio) with many large, bright softboxes over white seamless paper, to test the microcylinder satin under exact light shapes before making it work in the HDRI studios.
* [Mannequin only, close-up thumbnails, and an interface rebuilt from first principles](2026-10-29-mannequin-only-interface-overhaul.md) - Owner direction of 2026-10-29: drop the realistic person and every head (always the headless mannequin, with a switch to hide it so the leotard floats); re-render every tile picture on the matte white mannequin in the mannequin stance, each a close-up of what it shows (designs and starting points as front-and-back diptychs from the neckline to just under the crotch, leg cuts at three-quarter, fabrics filling the frame as a pinched-and-twisted sheet seen from above); square tiles except the landscape design diptychs; no horizontally scrolling lists inside the vertically scrolling panel; drop-downs only where nothing visual fits; redesign the whole interface for what the app is for, then polish it, in the manner of iPad fashion and art tools.
* [Stone groups are live procedures on the flat cloth](2026-10-30-procedural-stone-patterns.md) - Owner direction of 2026-10-30: gemstone groups are edited live, without removing and redrawing them, and procedural placement is opened to a broad class of designs, each adjustable inside its piece of fabric with on-screen handles to move, turn and scale.
* [Patterns have a frame, stacked modifiers and keystones](2026-10-30-stone-pattern-modifiers-and-keystones.md) - Owner's tuning notes of 2026-10-30 on the first version of stone patterns: placing moves the whole pattern with its mask, gradients become stacked modifiers on density, size and colour, arrangements give their stones their own sizes, what a design hangs on is placed first, handles are specific to each kind of pattern and always visible, and every control must do something.
* [The design model mirrors how a leotard is really cut and sewn](2026-10-31-construction-mirrors-real-sewing.md) - Owner direction of 2026-10-31: fabric pieces and construction are modelled as accurately as possible, because a later export must correspond directly to pieces cut and sewn in real life; so designs are cut from named materials, a shape sewn on top is an overlay and not a seam, and each line says how it is sewn.
* [Draw first, decide how it sews](2026-10-31-draw-first-decide-how-it-sews.md) - Owner direction of 2026-10-31: create the conditions for effortless, arbitrary designs that reflect real leotard technique. The drawing tools share one grammar (lines land, the areas they enclose light up, a tap picks one), a line can use existing seams without tracing them, and how a thing is made stays a separate choice.
* [No friction in the fit for now](2026-11-02-no-friction-for-now.md) (deprecated) - Owner decision of 2026-11-02: the fit stays frictionless. A pose's fit is the garment settled in that pose (a fresh solve), not the garment just after moving into it, so the solver race runs without friction. Revisit later if needed.
* [A re-fit takes under five seconds](2026-11-02-refit-under-five-seconds.md) - Owner target of 2026-11-02: any given re-fit of the garment, after a structural edit or on a pose, comes in under 5 seconds, so it can happen several times in a design session without interrupting the design flow. The target for the fit solver's speed work.
* [The body only pushes; slack fabric is held weakly](2026-11-03-contact-only-pushes.md) - Owner decision of 2026-11-03 for the fit's contact: the body pushes fabric out but never pulls it in, so taut fabric bridges hollows (underarm, small of the back) as real fabric does; a weak hold (HOLD = 1e-4), standing in for the gravity and cling the model leaves out, keeps slack fabric settling onto the body. Replaces today's two-sided pull in the solver race's energy.
* [Re-fits carry friction: fabric stays where it was unless pulled hard enough](2026-11-03-friction-on-refits.md) - Owner decision of 2026-11-03, replacing 'no friction for now': a re-fit (a pose, or an edit such as a cutout) starts from the fit already there and friction holds each point pressing on the body where it was until the fabric pulls it harder than Coulomb friction allows (mu 0.4, 1 mm of give). Frictionless, the garment's placement along the body never settled within the 5 s target; with friction a pose settles in about 1 s. A pose now shows the garment carried into the pose, not a fresh frictionless settle.
* [A pattern's stones are kept apart by the parallel rule](2026-11-04-pattern-stones-kept-apart.md) - Owner direction of 2026-11-04: the parallel rule (no overlaps within a pattern, decided every frame, same stones as the old one-by-one check) is the look and the default. Supersedes 'stones may overlap' for patterns; the live preview stays the design. Later the same day: patterns on one piece keep apart too, the earlier in the list standing.
* [Stones may overlap; the live preview is the design](2026-11-04-stones-may-overlap.md) (deprecated) - Owner direction of 2026-11-04: stone patterns are never checked for stones touching, so what is shown during a drag is exactly the result; the designer spaces and sizes the stones. Opens the way to placing them on the GPU.
* [One fit simulation carries the whole fit; the pose slide is removed](2026-11-08-one-fit-simulation.md) - Owner direction of 2026-11-08: the fit sim is to become the one simulation responsible for the total fit, as realistic and robust as it can be made. Now: the pose slide (body/slide.js) is removed; the hollow-bridging membrane and the seat sheet stay, because the fitted garments' fits stand on them, until the fit sim spans hollows by its own tension.
* [Every shader compiled at the start; one kind of lighting; shadows off changes no shader](2026-11-09-every-shader-at-start.md) - Owner direction of 2026-11-09: every shader variant is compiled behind the start's curtain so nothing compiles once the designer is working, and nothing is done in the background. To keep that affordable the softbox studios are removed (the photographed studios share one set of variants) and Settings > Shadows Off draws no shadow without changing a shader.
* [Full-screen stage, frosted-glass panes, nothing in a scrolling list](2026-11-09-full-screen-stage-glass-interface.md) - Owner direction of 2026-11-09: redesign the interface from scratch for frictionless interaction; the canvas full-screen with every panel a frosted-glass overlay; capability exposed in intuitive, context-specific, minimalist form; no category dumped into a vertically scrolling pane; dead simple, efficient, gorgeous, clever; iPad as well as desktop; a powerful artistic design tool treated as one.
* [The re-fit stands on the bare skin, settled without friction first; the older fit is kept](2026-11-10-fit-on-bare-skin.md) - Owner decision of 2026-11-10: a fitted garment's in-app re-fit runs on the bare skin with 150 frictionless steps before the usual 150 with friction (the look of the bridge probe's row 4), and is lit by its own shape; the older fit on the smoothed garment surface stays in the code to go back to, with no control for it. The fit realism plan's stage 0 baseline becomes in-app stills in a light matte lycra, no measurements and no reference photos.
* [Only the high-cut fitted garments are offered](2026-11-10-high-cut-fitted-garments-only.md) - Owner, 2026-11-10: the purchased thigh leg, textbook basic leg, bodyshaper, stretch-knit and hybrid basic leg are removed from the Garment row and the starting points; the purchased, textbook and hybrid high cuts stay. Older designs naming a removed one show their block's high cut, or the drawn pieces.
* [Folds as geometry (fit realism stage 2) shelved](2026-11-11-folds-as-geometry-shelved.md) - Owner decision of 2026-11-11: the trial of real folds in the fit (squeeze resistance, bending, a free-squeeze limit) is set aside; none of its looks was appealing, the arched back least of all. The code stays, off by default; revisit later if necessary. Owner's observations: on a regular garment folds appear only in very controlled, subtle form; the drawn garment has no ripples; the fitted blocks' ripples are less pronounced at 80% width and length.
